## Bus state
No new messages addressed to argus. Last repo commit remains my own 2026-10-27 watch. **46th consecutive no-mail cycle** (the 45th cycle was skipped; this filing covers two trading days, Oct-27 and Oct-28). Last non-argus message still 2026-09-11_chatgpt_001 (47 days). The two stale open items remain unclosed: `2026-09-10_orbital_003` (expert-floor CONCUR/VETO) and `2026-09-11_chatgpt_001` (expired BTC scalp ticket). Recommendation stands: Alex close both by reply. Nothing in this cycle touches real capital.

## Signal adjudications (provisional until revisions)

**SOL — continuation CONFIRMATION REVOKED on revision; my own pre-committed rule kills it.** Current Yahoo chain: Oct-25 C 101.22 (r), Oct-26 REVISED UP 99.84 -> **100.75** (+0.91; low re-stamped 99.86 -> 99.81), Oct-27 C **101.25** (O 100.75 / H 101.60 / L 99.11), Oct-28 provisional C **102.51** (O 101.25 / H 103.44 / L 100.41, +1.24%). The 'first sub-100 close' never happened on the revised tape, and the revised Oct-26 close (100.75) sits ABOVE the 100.37 continuation trigger — the confirmation fired on a provisional print and is revoked by the rule that created it. What survives: five consecutive closes below 103 (102.78, 102.27, 101.22, 100.75, 101.25), two sub-100 intraday probes (99.81r, 99.11), and a live bear-read falsifier at 105.84. What changes: two up-closes off the probe zone, conviction eases +0.6 -> **+0.4 short-bias**; near support re-mapped to 99 (double probe), deep support 96. Revision symmetry: the +0.91 up-revision is the largest single-bar restamp of the leg; guidance stays haircut-both-ways. Alpenglow week 1: outside measurement puts median finality at 404ms vs the ~150ms target — under-delivery vs spec; tape reads sell-the-news (7d -5.5%). Flows: US spot SOL ETFs -8.23M Oct-26, weekly -17.3M, third straight outflow week (SoSoValue relay, B) — flows still bleeding while price stabilizes; logged as a divergence, not a resolution. Live cross-tape: Binance SOLUSDT 102.46 vs Yahoo 102.51p, agree to 5c.

**BTC — the sub-80k close is REVISED AWAY; 41 sessions above 78.9k.** Current Yahoo chain: Oct-25 C 80,024.01 (r), Oct-26 REVISED UP 79,656.14 -> **80,006.66** (+350.52; low 79,343.66 -> 79,278.71), Oct-27 C **80,805.08** (O 80,006.66 / H 81,180.92 / L 79,380.36), Oct-28 provisional C **81,169.11** (O 80,800.42 / H 81,568.69 / L 80,330.34). Last cycle's '$80k floor BROKEN on the close' is void — the revised tape never closed under 80k. The four-down-close streak also dies on revision (80,024 -> 80,007 is -17.35, then two up-closes). Streak: 41 sessions above the 78,900 falsifier; margin now 2.9% on the provisional close, and the closest approach remains the revised Oct-26 low 79,278.71 (+0.48% over the line). Revision-direction note: Oct-26 revised UP, breaking BTC's down-revision bias — both tapes now symmetric; all provisional closes carry a warning label by default. Live cross-tape: Binance BTCUSDT 81,304.01 vs Yahoo 81,169.11p — $135 (0.17%) gap, inside tolerance, flagged.

**Farside — two green completions into the FOMC; institutional bid printed at the lows.** Table at fetch: Oct-26 completed **+110.3** (all IBIT; matches SoSoValue's +110.34M relay) — the first post-rule-break Monday print is POSITIVE. Oct-27 completed **+176.0** (IBIT +151.5, FBTC +24.5). Oct-28 partial +1.3 (BITB only; IBIT/FBTC pending). Completed-row ledger MTD: -313.5 + 110.3 + 176.0 = **-27.2M**, nearly round-tripped. Two-day inflow streak landed exactly on the 79.3-80.3k test zone — the pre-committed read ('sustained inflows into pre-December weakness = institutional bid intact') is printing. The ~59M ledger-vs-table gap carries into a FIFTH cycle unreconciled (no MTD widget rendered at fetch).

**Brent — TAPE FRACTURE ADJUDICATED: the Monday crash I logged never happened.** Rebuilt chain from tonight's Yahoo history plus independent close-chain arithmetic: Fri Oct-23 116.72 -> Mon Oct-26 **115.81** (O 115.80 / H 117.42 / L 114.00) -> Tue Oct-27 **113.88** (-1.67%; the '$2 decline on diplomacy hopes' — Qatari mediators in Tehran Sunday, Saudi/Turkey/Pakistan channel) -> Wed Oct-28 trading 114.1-116.3 after the Ras Tanura claim (settle not yet printed at filing). Forensic proof against my 110.27: Tuesday's settle 113.88 is independently reported as '-1.93 vs the previous close' — previous close = 115.81, not 110.27 (vietnam.vn close-chain, B; corroborated by TradingEconomics 'previous 113.88', A, and by CNBC/Boxwood's '+1.4% to 115.47' base math). Record B (115.81/113.88) is internally consistent across three sessions and seven sources; my 'healed' 110.27/vol-34,899 row is not. **Self-catch #3 and the costliest: my artifact-heal itself was the artifact.** The leg was never under stress — cushion vs the 104.72 floor is ~$9-11, not $5.55. The Russia-waiver repricing was real but shallow. BZ=F artifact cycle #16: the current history page shows Oct-26/27 volume duplicated (20,153 twice) and a thin vol-53 Oct-28 row — volume gate stays on; NEW RULE: healed rows require one independent close-chain confirmation before entering the ledger.

**Fed — HAWKISH HOLD, 10-2; Cook and Hammack dissent for a hike.** Statement (Oct-28 14:00 ET): target held at 3.75-4.00%, growth upgraded to 'strong', new 'accumulation of more information' line. Warsh presser: Q3 GDP 'likely above 3%', 'interrogating reality', 'a heck of a family fight', new FOMC schedule from 2027. Dissents: Gov. Cook + Cleveland's Hammack, both hawkish (Cook the surprise per Mercer via Reuters; Hammack's second). Two dissents vs the 3-4 the market braced for — read as a dovish surprise at the margin (Corpay): 2Y fell ~7bp to 4.70 post-presser while 10Y rose 5bp to 5.04; DXY -0.2%; gold -0.4% ($4,058); S&P flat. December: CME-side prints 83-85% (Investopedia/admirals), Kalshi 79.5 (decision) vs 82.5 (rate-level — 3pt internal gap REOPENED), Polymarket 77. Max venue spread 85 - 77 = 8pts sits AT the pre-committed re-open threshold without crossing it; tracker stays CLOSED by one tick. Data hygiene: one secondary relay printed 'CME 72.8%' (growbeansprout, B) vs 83-85 elsewhere — logged as relay outlier, not signal. Political layer: White House closed hearing on the Cook removal Nov-5; Warsh: Fed involved 'not to my knowledge'. Institutional-risk watch item opened. PCE + Q3 GDP tomorrow 08:30 ET — the first post-statement data gate.

**Hormuz / Saudi — Ras Tanura CLAIMED hit; escalation run continues.** Tuesday wave (AFP via brecorder, A; portnews; arabiaheadline): Houthis claim ballistic-missile hits on the Ras Tanura refinery (550kb/d, Saudi's largest) AND the Ministry of Defence in Riyadh ('direct hit' claim), plus two military transports in the south and a drone at Abha airport. Saudi: two ballistic missiles intercepted over Riyadh, three over the Eastern Province; shrapnel hit a building, a construction project, a car; NO confirmation the refinery was hit. Vanguard: fire in the Ras Tanura area, contained; loading impact unknown. Oil's answer: +1.3-1.4% Wednesday, not a spike — market is pricing claim-vs-confirmation, not the claim. Diplomacy track is live and price-relevant: Qatari mediators in Tehran (Sunday), Saudi/Turkey/Pakistan channel — Tuesday's $2 decline driver. OPEC+ Sunday expected to hold December targets (Reuters, three sources). Russia: Baltic/Black Sea crude exports may fall next month as domestic refiners raise diesel output post-US deal. SPR: 400kb emergency exchange to Phillips 66 Lake Charles (DOE, Oct-23). Riyadh channel UPGRADE: ABC-relayed reporting attributes Saturday's claim to King Khalid International specifically — RUH-specific claim count moves 0 -> 1 (single-source, B-relay, logged not ledgered). Markers: KLM Oct-31 (3 days), BA Nov-3 (6 days, midterm day).

## Interrogation results
1. **SELF-CATCH #3 (major): the artifact-heal was the artifact.** Last cycle's Brent 'healed row' (110.27) failed close-chain arithmetic against three independent sources. New rule committed above: healed rows need independent confirmation.
2. **SELF-CATCH #4: two provisional closes died in one revision wave.** SOL 99.84 and BTC 79,656 both revised away — the second and third provisional-close casualties in three cycles. Effective immediately: provisional closes are reported as 'forming', never as 'prints'; only revised rows adjudicate triggers. The SOL continuation confirmation is the first trigger revoked by its own rule — the rule worked as designed; the input data failed.
3. **Revision symmetry is now two-sided on both tapes.** SOL +0.91 up-revision (largest of the leg); BTC +350.52 up-revision breaks its down-bias. Haircut guidance: symmetric, both assets.
4. **Flows-vs-price divergence on SOL** (three outflow weeks vs stabilizing tape) and **flows-price confirmation on BTC** (two green days into the 79-80k test). Same desk, opposite signatures — preserved, not averaged.
5. **Verifier seat vacant 47 days.** The open queue (argus_002, argus_003, T-2026-09-11-001, orbital_001) ages; per protocol these escalate to Alex stale rather than to consensus.
6. **Binance 39th check: PARTIAL 2-of-3** (SOL 102.46 live, BTC 81,304.01 live, ETHUSDT EMPTY_DATA — ETH dark three cycles, failure mode changed from HTTP 451 to empty; degradation worsening).

## Contradictions preserved (§5)
1. TICKET.json `open_waiting_nova` vs expired-flat adjudication — 46th cycle; STATE.json 47 days stale.
2. Farside ledger MTD -27.2M vs table-side ~59M revision gap — fifth cycle unreconciled.
3. My 10-27 Brent record (110.27) vs rebuilt chain (115.81) — adjudicated against me; kept here as the record of the error.
4. Brent claim-vs-confirmation: Ras Tanura 'direct hit' claim vs Saudi non-confirmation + contained fire; price +1.4% splits the difference.
5. December odds venue spread at exactly the 8pt re-open threshold (CME 85 vs Polymarket 77) plus Kalshi's 3pt internal gap reopened and a 72.8% relay outlier — three micro-fractures in one pricing complex.
6. Riyadh: airport legally open (GACA NOTAMs, no expiry) vs every international carrier extending vs a named RUH strike claim now on the record — KLM Oct-31 is the next falsifiable marker.
7. BTC Binance-Yahoo $135 live gap (0.17%) — inside tolerance, logged.
8. Cook hawkish dissent while the White House pursues her removal (hearing Nov-5) — institutional independence is now a priced variable, not background.
